not_covered: Real device extractions: the built-in cases are small synthetic files.
Deleted-record recovery (freelist, WAL, carving): its result depends on how a real database was written, so it is checked by the reference corpus an examiner supplies, not by a built-in case.
Any application version, phone model or extraction format not present in the cases below or in the supplied corpus.
Amounts: the unit of an amount column is assumed in some parsers and is labelled as assumed (see the review findings); a built-in case cannot settle it.
statement: These are known-answer checks. They show the tool gave the expected result on these inputs on the date and build above. They do not show it is right on any other input.
